translations.Can not impersonate. Please contact your: Can not impersonate. Please contact your server administrator to allow impersonation.

translations.Can not impersonate a user who has never: Can not impersonate a user who has never logged in
translations.Do you want to log in as user \"{user}\": Do you want to log in as user "{user}"? Everything you do until you log out is done as this user.

translations.The URL signing key of your account was: The URL signing key of your account was removed for security reasons at the end of an impersonation of your account. A new key is created when one is needed.
